132:                    stacklevel=2,

181:        have the value :obj:`None` or are empty instances of :class:`collections.abc.Sized` (e.g.
182:        :class:`list`, :class:`dict`, :class:`set`, :class:`str`, etc.).
183:

199:        else:

201:            as_dict["api_kwargs"] = dict(self.api_kwargs)

203:        contents = ", ".join(
204:            f"{k}={as_dict[k]!r}"
205:            for k in sorted(as_dict.keys())
206:            if (
207:                as_dict[k] is not None
208:                and not (
209:                    isinstance(as_dict[k], Sized)
210:                    and len(as_dict[k]) == 0  # type: ignore[arg-type]

231:

235:        Returns:

238:        Raises:

477:    def _apply_api_kwargs(self, api_kwargs: JSONDict) -> None:
478:        """Loops through the api kwargs and for every key that exists as attribute of the
479:        object (and is None), it moves the value from `api_kwargs` to the attribute.
480:        *Edits `api_kwargs` in place!*
481:
482:        This method is currently only called in the unpickling process, i.e. not on "normal" init.
483:        This is because
484:        * automating this is tricky to get right: It should be called at the *end* of the __init__,
485:          preferably only once at the end of the __init__ of the last child class. This could be
486:          done via __init_subclass__, but it's hard to not destroy the signature of __init__ in the
487:          process.
488:        * calling it manually in every __init__ is tedious
489:        * There probably is no use case for it anyway. If you manually initialize a TO subclass,
490:          then you can pass everything as proper argument.
491:        """
492:        # we convert to list to ensure that the list doesn't change length while we loop
493:        for key in list(api_kwargs.keys()):
494:            # property attributes are not settable, so we need to set the private attribute
495:            if isinstance(getattr(self.__class__, key, None), property):
496:                # if setattr fails, we'll just leave the value in api_kwargs:
497:                with contextlib.suppress(AttributeError):
498:                    setattr(self, f"_{key}", api_kwargs.pop(key))
499:            elif getattr(self, key, True) is None:
500:                setattr(self, key, api_kwargs.pop(key))

502:    def _get_attrs_names(self, include_private: bool) -> Iterator[str]:
503:        """
504:        Returns the names of the attributes of this object. This is used to determine which
505:        attributes should be serialized when pickling the object.
506:
507:        Args:
508:            include_private (:obj:`bool`): Whether to include private attributes.
509:
510:        Returns:
511:            Iterator[:obj:`str`]: An iterator over the names of the attributes of this object.
512:        """
513:        # We want to get all attributes for the class, using self.__slots__ only includes the
514:        # attributes used by that class itself, and not its superclass(es). Hence, we get its MRO
515:        # and then get their attributes. The `[:-1]` slice excludes the `object` class
516:        all_slots = (s for c in self.__class__.__mro__[:-1] for s in c.__slots__)  # type: ignore
517:        # chain the class's slots with the user defined subclass __dict__ (class has no slots)
518:        all_attrs = (
519:            chain(all_slots, self.__dict__.keys()) if hasattr(self, "__dict__") else all_slots

155:            Only the offsets and lengths calulated in UTF-16 is acceptable by the Telegram Bot API.

173:                    MessageEntity(offset=9, length=6, type=MessageEntity.ITALIC),
174:                    MessageEntity(offset=28, length=3, type=MessageEntity.UNDERLINE),
175:                ]

177:                    text, unicode_entities
178:                )

180:                    chat_id=123,
181:                    text=text,
182:                    entities=utf_16_entities,
183:                )

185:                # utf_16_entities[1]: offset=11, length=6
186:                # utf_16_entities[2]: offset=30, length=6

188:        Args:

193:        Returns:
194:            Sequence[:class:`telegram.MessageEntity`]: Sequence of entities
195:            with offset and length calculated in UTF-16 encoding
196:        """
197:        # get sorted positions
198:        positions = sorted(itertools.chain(*((x.offset, x.offset + x.length) for x in entities)))
199:        accumulated_length = 0
200:        # calculate the length of each slice text[:position] in utf-16 accordingly,
201:        # store the position translations
202:        position_translation: dict[int, int] = {}
203:        for i, position in enumerate(positions):
204:            last_position = positions[i - 1] if i > 0 else 0
205:            text_slice = text[last_position:position]
206:            accumulated_length += len(text_slice.encode(TextEncoding.UTF_16_LE)) // 2
207:            position_translation[position] = accumulated_length
208:        # get the final output entities
209:        out = []
210:        for entity in entities:
211:            translated_positions = position_translation[entity.offset]
212:            translated_length = (
213:                position_translation[entity.offset + entity.length] - translated_positions
214:            )
215:            new_entity = copy.copy(entity)
216:            with new_entity._unfrozen():
217:                new_entity.offset = translated_positions
218:                new_entity.length = translated_length
219:            out.append(new_entity)
